facts.statement: Sports Week included soccer challenges at the Snowy Hill field during the week and a sports-themed party on Tuesday.
facts.quote: desafíos de fútbol en el campo de Colina Nevada durante la semana, junto con una fiesta con un tema muy deportivo el martes

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Campamento de Verano – Semana Deportiva)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Free Realms Summer Camp event, covering its Sports Week theme. It gives the scheduled times for in-game community events and explains how to reach them via the Game Guide calendar. The exact post date is not shown (only 'Posted 10 months, 4 weeks ago' relative to capture), so it is undated.
